verifiedBehavior: The initial hash is signed, valid for ten minutes and creates no database row when polled anonymously.
Only a current owner or admin can create the transfer; bearer callers remain inside their source organization.
The browser handoff passes at 1440 and 390 pixels without page errors or overflow.
The payload returns the actual project, full DSN, enabled keys and a scoped source-map credential.
The official @sentry/wizard 8.0.1 completes login/project selection, creates .sentryclirc and a working script, then exits zero.
Deleting the hash removes the handoff; migration 051 preserves existing credentials and reopens twice.
